quotes.text: "After adding a feed, the certificate exception button should not be shown"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: updateStatusItem collapses the validator link unless the code is kNewsBlogInvalidFeed, and collapses the certificate-exception button unless the code is kNewsBlogBadCertError. The direct successful-add test asserts that both are hidden after the add button becomes hidden. It does not directly cover either matching error's visible state or certificate exception behavior. This is exact source/test intent, without a live rendering or network result.
title: Feed status controls collapse for nonmatching error codes
